milestones.label: Applications open for the 2027-2028 call
milestones.source_text: The Swiss State Secretariat for Education page (official) says applications are open from 20 August 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline
milestones.source_text: The official page says deadlines are published per country of origin, so no single date applies. Third-party and embassy-linked notices mention 10 and 20 November 2026 for some countries.

milestones.label: Federal Commission announces award decisions
milestones.source_text: The official page says the commission announces its decisions by the end of May at the latest; the page is titled for the 2027-2028 awards but does not print the year.
